clippings.speaker: Robert Zemeckis
clippings.quote: Jodie Foster or Tom Hanks will make anything work.
clippings.title: Far Sighted: DGA Interview with Robert Zemeckis
clippings.context: Interview in the Spring 2013 DGA Quarterly, answering how actors handle unnatural physical requests on set.

clippings.speaker: Robert Zemeckis
clippings.quote: I remember he started doing the scene and I started getting really emotional…
clippings.title: Behind the Scenes with Robert Zemeckis
clippings.context: Recalling Hanks's performance in Jenny's death scene in Forrest Gump, in an El Rey Network interview.

clippings.speaker: Robert Zemeckis
clippings.quote: It's a minefield, Tom. It's a goddamn minefield.
clippings.title: Behind the Scenes with Tom Hanks
clippings.context: Zemeckis's reply, as Hanks recalls it in a 2023 New Yorker Radio Hour interview, when Hanks worried about the Forrest Gump dialogue and whether anyone would care.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: until we got Bob Zemeckis on in order to give us the third act…
clippings.title: Behind the Scenes with Tom Hanks
clippings.context: Hanks says the Cast Away project made no progress until Zemeckis came on to write the third act, in a 2023 New Yorker Radio Hour interview.

notes: Zemeckis direction is stronger than Hanks's; the Hanks-on-Zemeckis side has only two verified lines. Variety's 2023 Forrest Gump piece returned HTTP 402 (skipped). The NPR Here interview timed out, so its 'make all my movies with Hanks' remark is not included. Dates are original-publication dates where known; the Variety Pinocchio date is approximate (premiere week).
